text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Is this a photo from when you went 
rock climbing?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When I reached the summit, there 
were cherry blossoms everywhere! It was 
gorgeous~. I took a bunch of photos!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And and, the mountain's name was pretty 
interesting too. They say it's called 
'Mount Mairu' because everyone goes there 
to visit the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I want to climb that mountain too! Please! 
Pretty, pretty, pretty please!!" his

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Gran-chan's eyes are sparkling so 
brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In that case, want to try climbing it with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll climb up first to secure the 
way, so just follow behind me, Gran-chan! 
—I know you can do it, Gran-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! No matter what route it takes, I'll 
definitely conquer anything with "Mile" in 
its name~!
